prompt_data.main_prompt: Design a minimalist tech T-shirt for DreamShaperXL Turbo, featuring clean typography and geometric shapes in a monochromatic color scheme. The design should be simple yet eye-catching, focusing on modern aesthetics that would appeal to tech enthusiasts. Avoid overly complex compositions or busy patterns, as these can look blurry when printed on-demand.
prompt_data.negative_prompt: Avoid using low-quality images, overly crowded designs, and unprofessional typography. Keep the composition clean and minimal, with ample space around graphic elements.
